## Basic Structure

Track records user actions as events with optional properties.

**Payload:**
```json
{
  "type": "track",
  "event": "User Registered",
  "properties": {
    "plan": "Pro Annual",
    "accountType": "Facebook"
  }
}
```

**JavaScript SDK:**
```js
analytics.track("User Registered", {
  plan: "Pro Annual",
  accountType: "Facebook"
});
```

## Track Call Fields

| Field | Required | Type | Notes |
|-------|----------|------|-------|
| `event` | Yes | String | Human-readable action name (e.g., "User Registered", "Order Completed"). Avoid nondescript names like "Event 12". |
| `properties` | No | Object | Free-form event data. Reserved properties: `revenue`, `currency`, `value`. |
| `context` | No | Object | Extra metadata (see Context Fields below). Include `context.traits` to pass user traits to Actions destinations. |

## Reserved Properties

| Property | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| `revenue` | Number | Dollar amount (decimal, e.g., `19.99`). |
| `currency` | String | ISO 4217 currency code (e.g., `USD`). Defaults to USD if omitted. |
| `value` | Number | Abstract value for non-revenue events (e.g., newsletter signups). |

## Context Fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `active` | Boolean | Whether user is active (flags to update traits only, not "last seen"). |
| `app` | Object | `{name, version, build}` — auto-collected from mobile libraries. |
| `campaign` | Object | `{name, source, medium, term, content, ...}` — maps UTM parameters. |
| `device` | Object | `{id, advertisingId, manufacturer, model, name, type, version}`. |
| `ip` | String | Current user's IP address. |
| `library` | Object | `{name, version}` — the SDK making the request. |
| `locale` | String | Locale string (e.g., `en-US`). |
| `network` | Object | `{bluetooth, carrier, cellular, wifi}`. User is offline if cellular/wifi empty. |
| `os` | Object | `{name, version}`. |
| `page` | Object | Browser page: `{path, referrer, search, title, url}` (auto-collected by Analytics.js). |
| `referrer` | Object | `{type, name, url, link}`. |
| `screen` | Object | `{density, height, width}`. |
| `timezone` | String | tzdata string (e.g., `America/New_York`). |
| `groupId` | String | Account/Company ID for B2B attribution. |
| `traits` | Object | User traits (same as Identify call traits). Use for Actions destinations to trigger multiple actions from one Track event. |
| `userAgent` | String | Device user agent string. |
| `userAgentData` | Object | `{brands, mobile, platform, bitness, model, platformVersion, ...}` (Client Hints API if available). |
| `channel` | String | Source: `server`, `browser`, or `mobile`. |

## Identities

- **userId**: Unique user identifier (automatically added in browser/mobile libraries from prior Identify call — don't manually add).
- **anonymousId**: Pseudo-unique identifier when user identity unknown (also auto-handled by libraries).

## Complete Example Payload

```json
{
  "anonymousId": "23adfd82-aa0f-45a7-a756-24f2a7a4c895",
  "context": {
    "library": {
      "name": "analytics.js",
      "version": "2.11.1"
    },
    "page": {
      "path": "/academy/",
      "referrer": "",
      "search": "",
      "title": "Analytics Academy",
      "url": "https://segment.com/academy/"
    },
    "userAgent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10_11_0) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/46.0.2490.86 Safari/537.36",
    "ip": "108.0.78.21"
  },
  "event": "Course Clicked",
  "integrations": {},
  "messageId": "ajs-f8ca1e4de5024d9430b3928bd8ac6b96",
  "properties": {
    "title": "Intro to Analytics"
  },
  "receivedAt": "2015-12-12T19:11:01.266Z",
  "sentAt": "2015-12-12T19:11:01.169Z",
  "timestamp": "2015-12-12T19:11:01.249Z",
  "type": "track",
  "userId": "AiUGstSDIg",
  "originalTimestamp": "2015-12-12T19:11:01.152Z"
}
```

## Notes

- **Reserved properties only**: Use `revenue`, `currency`, `value` for their intended meaning only. Segment auto-converts destination-specific formats.
- **context.traits for Actions**: Pass user traits via `context.traits` to enable a single Track event to trigger multiple Actions destination events (without updating Unify profile — use Identify for that).
- **Semantic events**: Segment reserves specific event names with special meaning; see Semantic Events docs for reserved event names and event-specific properties.
